import numpy as np
one=np.ones_like(t)
def nm_w(w,K):
    cols=[one/P,t/P,P*np.log(P),t]
    for k in range(1,K+1):
        cols+= [np.sin(k*w*t)/P,np.cos(k*w*t)/P]
    A=np.column_stack(cols)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]; r=dP_dt-A@c
    return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt),c
